mapper.sql: a.id as id ,a.taolun_id as taolunId ,a.huifuren_id as huifurenId ,a.huifuren_table as huifurenTable ,a.huifuren_role as huifurenRole ,COALESCE( a.huifuren_name, CASE WHEN a.huifuren_table = 'xuesheng' THEN xuesheng.xuesheng_name WHEN a.huifuren_table = 'laoshi' THEN laoshi.laoshi_name WHEN a.huifuren_table = 'qiye' THEN qiye.qiye_name WHEN a.huifuren_table = 'users' THEN users.username ELSE '' END ) as huifurenName ,a.huifu_content as huifuContent ,a.create_time as createTime ,a.update_time as updateTime
